text:
Predicates:
MemberOfPappys(x) ::: x is a member of Pappy's.
StarredIn(x, y) ::: x starred in y.
Series(y) ::: y is a series.
PilotedIn(y, z) ::: y was piloted in z.
Network(y, z) ::: y was broadcast on z.
WorkingTitle(y, t) ::: y's working title was t.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x was the script editor for y.
Premises:
Badults :: Series
PilotedIn(Badults, July2013) ::: Badults was piloted in July 2013
Network(Badults, BBCThree) ::: Badults was broadcast on BBC Three
WorkingTitle(Badults, TheSecretDudeSociety) ::: The working title for Badults was 'The Secret Dude Society'
ScriptEditor(AndrewCollins, Badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults
∀x (MemberOfPappys(x) → StarredIn(x, Badults)) ::: No members of Pappy's have starred in a show piloting on BBC Two or BBC Three (to be proven false, but the statement's truth value is to be determined).
Conclusion:
¬∃x (MemberOfPappys(x) ∧ StarredIn(x, y) ∧ PilotedIn(y, z) ∧ (z = BBCTwo ∨ z = BBCThree)) ::: No members of Pappy's have starred in a show piloting on BBC Two or BBC Three (the statement to evaluate).
